description.value: Hamada Fusion is a multi-cuisine cafe and restaurant on Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, blending Filipino, Japanese, Korean, and Western culinary traditions under one roof. The extensive menu spans sushi rolls and nigiri, Korean tteokbokki, gyoza, tempura, and Western-style salads, offering a wide variety of flavours for groups with different tastes. The fusion concept was built around the idea of bringing people with different food preferences together at a single table.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record lists this as 'Hamada Sushi' but the discovered website (hamadafusion.com) consistently identifies the business as 'Hamada Fusion,' a multi-cuisine cafe at the same address — the business has rebranded. The website confirms the address (#200-22529 Lougheed Hwy, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 0L4) and provides two phone numbers absent from OSM. The prominent 'ORDER NOW' button across multiple pages confirms takeout availability; the menu lists several explicitly labelled vegetarian dishes. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
